angles.name: Devon Vibes

moments.title: Community Shield in Cardiff
moments.blurb: Manchester City takes on Arsenal in the FA Community Shield at Principality Stadium in Cardiff next Sunday, August 16, kicking off the new football season.

angles.name: Football Season Opener
angles.copy: The curtain-raiser for the new football season is next Sunday! Man City vs Arsenal in the Community Shield, live from Cardiff. Who's taking home the first silverware?

angles.name: Cardiff Hosts Big Game
angles.copy: Cardiff's Principality Stadium hosts the Community Shield next Sunday! A big game for the city and a chance to see some top-tier football.

angles.copy: From 'Sultans of Swing' to 'Money for Nothing', Mark Knopfler's guitar work is legendary. Celebrating his 77th this week!

moments.title: Summer Holidays Winding Down

angles.copy: Enjoying the final stretch of the summer holidays? Whether you're back to school soon or still have a bit of time, soak up that summer feeling!
